captions.caption: The video begins with a black screen.
A close-up view shows the long barrel of an artillery gun pointing skyward.
The gun barrel is held steady against the bright, cloudy sky.
The shot widens to reveal the artillery gun and several soldiers in a field.
Several soldiers in military uniforms are seen working around the artillery piece.
The artillery gun is positioned in an open field under an overcast sky.
Soldiers are actively preparing the large green artillery gun for use.
The crew is seen performing various tasks around the artillery equipment.
A soldier on the left adjusts his gear while others work on the gun.
The artillery team continues their coordinated efforts in the field.
A close-up shot focuses on a large green artillery shell standing on the ground.
The camera shows the texture and markings on the side of the shell.
The shot captures the conical top of the large artillery round.
A soldier's hand in a black glove reaches for the top of the shell.
The soldier begins to screw a fuse onto the tip of the artillery shell.
The close-up continues as the fuse is carefully adjusted by the soldier.
The fuse is now securely attached to the green artillery shell.
Several artillery shells are seen lined up on a wooden pallet.
The camera pans across the uniform rows of green artillery rounds.
Markings and numbers are visible on the sides of the stacked shells.
The shot of the artillery shells on the pallet continues.
A low-angle shot shows the muzzle brake of the artillery gun under a net.
The muzzle of the gun is framed by camouflage netting in the background.
The artillery gun is positioned and ready for its next fire mission.
The camera captures the details of the gun's muzzle brake from below.
The view of the artillery gun barrel from the ground remains steady.
Soldiers are unloading cylindrical containers from the back of a truck.
A soldier pulls a propellant charge container from the truck's storage rack.
The soldier lifts the container and turns to carry it away from the truck.
Another soldier on the truck bed handles more containers in the rack.
The soldier carrying the container walks toward the gun position.
Soldiers are working together to efficiently unload the truck's cargo.
The crew members are busy transferring the charge containers from the truck.
A soldier passes a propellant charge container to his teammate.
The team continues to unload and organize the necessary supplies.
A soldier reaches for another container on the truck's storage rack.
The rack on the truck is filled with rows of cylindrical charge containers.
A wide shot shows the artillery gun and the entire crew in the field.
Soldiers are moving about, preparing for the upcoming fire mission.
A soldier is heard shouting verbal commands to the rest of the crew.
The crew members are busy performing their individual tasks around the gun.
Soldiers are seen carrying equipment and rounds toward the artillery piece.
The activity around the artillery gun is purposeful and well-coordinated.
Soldiers are working under a camouflage net to stay hidden in the field.
Two soldiers are looking at targeting information on a paper or tablet.
The camera focuses on the soldiers operating the mechanical parts of the gun.
The artillery crew is getting ready to load a shell into the breech.
Soldiers are gathered at the back of the gun, ready for the loading process.
A soldier is seen checking a manual while others work on the gun.
The crew is focused on their tasks as they prepare the next round.
A soldier is looking at a handheld device while standing near the gun.
The camera pans back to show the gun and the crew in the field.
A group of soldiers runs toward the gun carrying a shell on a tray.
The crew lifts the tray to align the shell with the gun's breech.
Several soldiers push the artillery shell into the breech of the gun.
The crew uses a rammer to seat the shell firmly into the gun barrel.
The soldiers work together to finish loading the heavy artillery round.
After loading the shell, the crew members quickly move out of the way.
Another group of soldiers approaches the gun with the next shell tray.
The crew begins the process of loading another shell into the artillery gun.
